title: feat(nscfx): same-tick x formdraw n(C)=n(D): reverse UNDEFINED, face UNDEFINED
science: Proves the degenerate case the rest of the kernel family rests on: on nnseed x-probes with same-tick occupancy n(A)=n(C)=n(D)=(-1/3,0,0), so n(C)=n(D) exactly, no splitting axis mu* exists and all four letters are UNDEFINED. This is the computation #7092 cites as closing the x-probe unique-letter route.
